text.description_html:
Heart Black Iron Door Pull, Acorn RPEBP

This Heart Tip Black Iron pull handle is easily surface mounted to almost any door. They are often used on gates, barns doors and garage doors. Packaged with matching black iron finish mounting screws for easy installation.

Also see 11 inch Shooting Heart Door Pull.

Specifications of Acorn RPEBP Heart Door Pull

  • Pull Height: 8-1/2"
  • Width: 1-5/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/2"
  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Material: Cast Iron
  • Packaged with mounting screws
Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!
